origin.description: Rows of length r on a sphere in N+1 dimensions.
origin.details: Shape 5 by 3 and 1 when every row has length 3.
origin.value: Rows of length r on a sphere in N+1 dimensions.
origin.example: { x <- rands(5, N=2, r=3); c(dim(x), as.numeric(all(abs(sqrt(rowSums(x^2)) - 3) < 1e-8))) }

translation.description: Rows of length r on a sphere in N+1 dimensions.
translation.details: Shape 5 by 3 and 1 when every row has length 3.
translation.value: Rows of length r on a sphere in N+1 dimensions.
translation.example: (lambda x=rands(5, N=2, r=3): (lambda rad=np.sqrt(np.sum(x**2, axis=1)): np.concatenate([np.array(x.shape, float), [1.0 if np.all(np.abs(rad - 3) < 1e-8) else 0.0]]))())()
